about: Clips a picture, a video or a map to an aspect ratio and a corner radius.

blur.about: Every blur step over a landscape frame. The frame clips the softened edge of the picture.
blur.title: Blur

fit.about: A 16:9 picture in a portrait frame. `cover` crops the picture to the frame. `contain` shows all of it.
fit.title: Fit

hillside: Green hills with pine trees under a yellow sun

ratio.about: Every aspect ratio at every corner radius. Each frame is at most 320px wide.
ratio.title: Ratios and radii

title: Frame
